title.zh: 规定在宿务市Basak设立南方群岛医疗中心25张床位的延伸分院并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for An Extension Branch With a Twenty-five-bed Capacity of the Southern Islands Medical Center in Basak, City of Cebu, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for An Extension Branch With a Twenty-five-bed Capacity of the Southern Islands Medical Center in Basak, City of Cebu, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7330_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: An extension branch with a twenty-five-bed capacity of the Southern Islands Medical Center is hereby established in Basak, City of Cebu.

The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be charged against the appropriations authorized for the purpose under the current General Appropriations Act. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the hospital shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
